name: workspaces-instances
description: Amazon WorkSpaces Instances provides an API framework for managing virtual workspace environments across multiple AWS regions, enabling programmatic creation and configuration of desktop infrastructure.

subcommands.name: associate-volume
subcommands.description: Attaches a volume to a WorkSpace Instance.

subcommands.name: create-volume
subcommands.description: Creates a new volume for WorkSpace Instances.

subcommands.name: create-workspace-instance
subcommands.description: Launches a new WorkSpace Instance with specified configuration parameters, enabling programmatic workspace deployment.

subcommands.name: delete-workspace-instance
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified WorkSpace Usage of this API will result in deletion of the resource in question.

subcommands.name: disassociate-volume
subcommands.description: Detaches a volume from a WorkSpace Instance.

subcommands.name: get-workspace-instance
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific WorkSpace Instance.

subcommands.name: list-instance-types
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of instance types supported by Amazon WorkSpaces Instances, enabling precise workspace infrastructure configuration.

subcommands.name: list-regions
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of AWS regions supported by Amazon WorkSpaces Instances, enabling region discovery for workspace deployments.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Retrieves tags for a WorkSpace Instance.

subcommands.name: list-workspace-instances
subcommands.description: Retrieves a collection of WorkSpaces Instances based on specified filters.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds tags to a WorkSpace Instance.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from a WorkSpace Instance.
